author: National Geographic
description:
Dive into the world of illegal drugs with investigative journalist, Mariana van Zeller, in this Trafficked season 3 MEGA episode compilation. Go into the heart of Mexico's cartel land to learn about a new deadly fentanyl cocktail called "tranq dope." Then join Mariana on a mission to understand the power and creation of LSD. Finally, go to the Netherlands, the epicenter of the MDMA supply chain, and learn about the mob-infested underworld turning the country into a narco-state. 

Featuring three, full episodes: 

The Tranq Dope Underground - 00:00 
Mariana investigates a deadly new fentanyl cocktail called "tranq dope" that's devastating American users. She's spent her career covering the deadly waves of the country's opioid crisis, but she's never seen it this bad. Seeking answers, she heads to Sinaloa, the heart of Mexico's cartel land, to get answers, and makes a shocking discovery.
